sections.title: Sticky 72px top bar
sections.summary: (sumi): the hanko plus "KŌJI 麹", and on the right a **noren curtain** nav. That's five hanging shadow-grey panels split by slits, each with kanji (厨房 献立 塔 板前 予約), an English label from 900px up, and a 4px shu hem. On hover a panel turns shu and drops 4px.

sections.title: Kitchen
sections.summary: (béton slab): "Fermentation is the kitchen." Three pillars, each with giant kanji: 麹 Kōji, 味噌 Miso, 塩 Shio. Two photos.

sections.title: Omakase
sections.summary: (sumi): "Eleven courses. One counter." The **food flight** (below), then a menu card with the hanko, "Autumn menu · ¥38,000", and 11 courses in 5 groups in mono:
